summary: Pitney Bowes Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its credit agreement adding $150M incremental term loans, bringing total tranche A term borrowings to $302M. Proceeds were used, with other cash, to redeem $347M of 6.875% Senior Notes due 2027. The incremental loans share the same maturity and terms as existing term loans. The redemption eliminates a near-term maturity, extending overall debt profile. This is a liability management restructuring, not a standard refinancing. Watch for potential credit rating impact and whether further liability management steps follow.
